formattedAddress: No. 38號, Chaozhou St, Jinhua Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text: The kids loved the play area with ball pit slide and a whole wall of toy kitchens. I didn’t like that the play area and eating space were separate but overall a good experience. Friendly good service, clean and comfortable, average food. Play area is up to age 6. We paid 250 entrance per child +10% We ordered by QR code and the service was smooth. We arrived a bit before our reservation and had to wait outside. Need reservation.

text.text:
We had a wonderful time at Mr. Tree on a very cold winter day during our trip to Taipei. Our 6 month old son really enjoyed the play area, and we also had some nice food and drinks at the café. The staff were also friendly and helpful. A great place to spend a few hours with kids.

My wife also left her handbag behind and the next day, they sent it back to our hotel with balloons and little fun toys for our baby - super sweet of them!

text.text: We went with our daughter-in-law and 2yr old granddaughter. A nice restaurant with play centre attached, with dedicated staff in the play centre to keep things clean. Whole place had a calm relaxed feel and granddaughter had a good time.

text.text: This restaurant is a nice option for families with young children. It has a large ball pit for kids to play in, and safety guards are installed on all staircases. Hygiene is well maintained, with sanitisation required before entry. There’s also a separate area for children under two. The restrooms have a diaper-changing station, and the sinks include small steps for kids. The staff are friendly and helpful. Highly recommended for parents looking for a safe and enjoyable place to dine with their little ones.
